Wound,Ⓒs.ⒹvraRaH, kzataM, kzati f.; aruz n., IrmaM, AGAtaH, prahAraH; ‘a w(ound) in the flesh’ tvagvraRaH; ‘fresh w(ound)’ ArdrakzataM, sadyovraRaH.
Ⓔv. t.ⒹvyaT 4 P, kzaR 8 P, tud 6 P, A-aBi-han 2 U, kzi 5 P, vraR 10, Bid-Cid 7 P, vi-dF 9 P; See Offend, Hurt.
Ⓝ[Wound]ed,Ⓒa.Ⓓkzata, vraRita, Binna, vidDa, Binnadeha; [] ‘greatly w(ounded)’ kzatavikzata; ‘mortally w(ounded)’ Binnamarman.
